Software for the next stage of your business.

Novera is an IT outsourcing and development team. We build web, mobile and intelligent systems from idea to launch, or strengthen the team you already have.

Not just working — making your work easier.

We start with the business

Goals and processes first. Technology and code second.

We build for people

Even a complex system needs a clear experience behind it.

We plan for the future

Architecture that can be extended for new tasks.

What we do

Web & platforms

Websites that express your brand and web applications your customers come back to — from idea to launch with one team.

Mobile apps

Intuitive, smooth apps built to grow with your business — design, development and release with one team.

Integration & automation

We connect disconnected systems and turn repetitive tasks into clear, controllable workflows.

AI & data solutions

Actionable insights from your data and AI assistants tailored to your team’s tasks — with people in control of the outcome.

How we work

01
